technical.summary: Oversold technicals (RSI, Williams %R, Stoch) show potential reversal setup, but lack bullish confirmation from momentum, moving averages, and volume; weak trend strength and bearish price structure limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: AOS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings in 2 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional selling and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (421.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 2 days create severe macro headwinds and binary event risk for AOS.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI all below 40, Williams %R, Stoch 29.53) with Williams %R and Supertrend bullish signals create textbook reversal setup in fear zone (23/100 sentiment).
debate.key_bear_argument: Earnings binary event in 2 days combined with crisis VIX, price below all major moving averages, zero volume/momentum confirmation, and weak institutional alignment make this a high-risk trap with unfavorable macro environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Oversold technicals (RSI, Williams %R, Stoch) present reversal potential in extreme fear zone, but earnings binary event in 2 days and crisis macro environment eliminate swing trade viability.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 2 days creates uncontrollable binary event risk; crisis VIX (421.6) and price below all major moving averages indicate structural weakness without volume confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk, weak conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already 2 positions in Industrials; adding AOS increases sector concentration unnecessarily given unfavorable risk/reward.
